grades.quote: A `FENCE` (with _fm_ = `0000` ) orders all memory operations in its predecessor set before all memory operations in its successor set.
grades.reason: Directly describes RISC-V FENCE memory ordering instructions: predecessor/successor sets, I/O/R/W ordering bits, the fm field encoding, and FENCE.TSO semantics.
Only lists the LoongArch barrier instructions (DBAR, IBAR) in a table of LA32 instructions. It says nothing about their ordering guarantees or control fields.
Concerns hardware-maintained conflicts for control and status registers. It does not cover memory-ordering barriers or their guarantees.
Describes thread barrier synchronization, where all threads wait for each other at the end of a phase. It is not about hardware memory-ordering barriers or fence instructions.
